note: 十段发布平台站会双语草稿；设计：目标和进度对齐，区分试验收益与生产结果，协商评审带宽并确认当天交付。不是故障会议；未配音，不填时间轴。

series.title: 发布平台站会：提速、环境一致性与评审等待
series.premise: 每日平台站会跟踪本周构建提速目标，试验分支已改善耗时，但缓存、安全评审和环境一致性工作尚未全部验收。
series.outcome: 团队确认可交付的缓存隔离、固定摘要选择与环境一致性测试，分配评审和配对时段；今日只提交证据与评审，不承诺尚未验证的生产提速，缺口继续跟踪。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

phraseDefinitions.zh: 决定总耗时的关键路径
一起配对处理这项工作

recycling.note: 未来候选只供排期，不算实际复现；实际引用仅已有库、S03至S07和本场前段。

dialogues.title: 本周目标和今天可交付内容
dialogues.premise: 上午平台站会开始，生产构建中位耗时仍十二分钟。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分本周目标与当前实测，听出会议讨论边界。

lines.en: Okay, this week's build time target is eight minutes. Current production median is twelve.
lines.zh: 好，本周构建耗时目标八分钟。当前生产中位数十二分钟。

lines.en: I've been heads-down on dependency reuse. Yesterday's prototype reached nine, not eight.
lines.zh: 我一直专注依赖复用。昨天原型到了九分钟，不是八分钟。

lines.en: Was that measured on comparable runners? Faster hardware could explain the apparent gain.
lines.zh: 是在可比执行器上测的吗？更快硬件可能解释表面收益。

lines.en: Just to confirm, prototype results only, right? We haven't changed production scheduling yet.
lines.zh: 确认一下，只是原型结果，对吧？还没改生产调度。

lines.en: Security review also remains open today. Reuse can't skip verification of downloaded inputs.
lines.zh: 安全评审今天也未结束。复用不能跳过下载输入验证。

lines.en: Who's got bandwidth for the comparison? What's the ETA for repeatable measurements?
lines.zh: 谁有空做对比？可重复测量预计多久完成？

lines.en: I can check runner parity before lunch. Keep queue waiting separate from execution time.
lines.zh: 午饭前我查执行器一致性。排队等待与执行时间分开。

lines.en: So, let's take it offline for profiling. Today I'll bring stage-level timing evidence.
lines.zh: 那么性能分析会后详谈。今天我提供各阶段耗时证据。

lines.en: That keeps this update focused on progress. We don't need a live debugging session.
lines.zh: 这样更新聚焦进度。不需要现场调试。

lines.en: Fair, I'll report consumer-side work separately. Our test coverage needs attention as well.
lines.zh: 明白，我单独报告消费侧工作。测试覆盖也要关注。

dialogues.title: 关键路径缩短，不盲目并行
dialogues.premise: 目标八分钟，原型九分钟；需对齐执行器与测量范围。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出真正提速位置与不能直接并行的步骤。

lines.en: The critical path is dependency resolution. Parallel linting shaved about three minutes yesterday.
lines.zh: 关键路径是依赖解析。昨天并行lint大约省了三分钟。

lines.en: Okay, build time improved on the prototype. Just to confirm, tests stayed enabled?
lines.zh: 好，原型构建耗时改善。确认一下，测试仍启用？

lines.en: Yes, equivalent runners reproduce the gain. Uploading artifacts still waits for verification results.
lines.zh: 对，等价执行器复现收益。制品上传仍等待验证结果。

lines.en: Could uploads overlap the final tests? Sorry, not promotion, just the upload itself.
lines.zh: 上传能与最后测试重叠吗？抱歉，不是晋级，只是上传本身。

lines.en: Possible in a quarantined staging area. Failed tests must prevent release selection completely.
lines.zh: 可以放在隔离暂存区。测试失败必须完全阻止发布选择。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on cleanup. Partial uploads need attempt-specific identifiers and receipts.
lines.zh: 我关注清理。部分上传需要尝试专用标识和回执。

lines.en: Don't share mutable output directories between tasks. That risks measuring speed through corrupted results.
lines.zh: 任务间别共享可变输出目录。那可能靠损坏结果测出速度。

lines.en: So, what's the ETA for that design? Let's take it offline after updates.
lines.zh: 那么这个设计预计多久？更新后会后详谈。

lines.en: I'd rather review the existing prototype first. More concurrency can wait for isolation evidence.
lines.zh: 我宁愿先评审现有原型。更多并发等隔离证据。

lines.en: Fair, I'll keep uploads sequential today. We can split that experiment next week.
lines.zh: 明白，今天上传保持串行。下周拆出那个试验。

dialogues.title: 先隔离缓存，再讨论收益
dialogues.premise: 原型收益可复现，但上传并行留待下一轮，当前推进缓存隔离。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出缓存键和访问边界是验收内容而非可选项。

lines.en: Each cache namespace now separates projects. Keys include lockfile, platform, and toolchain versions.
lines.zh: 各缓存命名空间现在隔离项目。键包括锁文件、平台和工具链版本。

lines.en: Okay, critical path reuse needs that boundary. Just to confirm, no cached secrets?
lines.zh: 好，关键路径复用需要这个边界。确认一下，没有缓存秘密？

lines.en: Configuration and credentials are explicitly excluded. Managed configuration supplies approved dependency source references.
lines.zh: 配置和凭据明确排除。受管配置提供批准的依赖源引用。

lines.en: A cache hit still checks hashes, right? Otherwise speed could hide stale inputs.
lines.zh: 缓存命中仍检查哈希，对吧？否则速度可能掩盖陈旧输入。

lines.en: Yes, approved writers and signature checks remain. Untrusted branches cannot write release caches.
lines.zh: 对，批准写入者和签名检查保留。不可信分支不能写发布缓存。

lines.en: I'm on it for permission tests. Cross-project reads fail as expected now.
lines.zh: 权限测试我来做。跨项目读取现在按预期失败。

lines.en: Add cold-versus-warm output comparison as well. Isolation tests don't establish equivalent build results.
lines.zh: 也加冷暖缓存输出比较。隔离测试不能证明构建结果等价。

lines.en: So, that's today's missing acceptance evidence. Roughly how many test combinations remain?
lines.zh: 那么这是今天缺的验收证据。大约还剩多少测试组合？

lines.en: Two toolchain variants and interrupted writes. Incomplete cache objects must never be reused.
lines.zh: 两个工具链变体和中断写入。不完整缓存对象绝不能复用。

lines.en: Fair, I'll provide both fixture variants. That should make the review much clearer.
lines.zh: 明白，我提供两个测试样例变体。这样评审会清楚很多。

dialogues.title: 消费端选错版本，不是构建坏了
dialogues.premise: 缓存隔离进入验收，Anika报告消费端制品选择问题。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分构建输入缓存与发布制品选择的两个问题。

lines.en: Yesterday's smoke test selected a stale artifact. The nightly label hadn't advanced correctly.
lines.zh: 昨天冒烟测试选了陈旧制品。nightly标签没有正确更新。

lines.en: Okay, separate from the cache namespace work? Just to confirm, production wasn't affected?
lines.zh: 好，和缓存命名空间工作分开？确认一下，生产未受影响？

lines.en: Correct, the test consumer used a tag. Production selects a reviewed immutable digest.
lines.zh: 对，测试消费端用了标签。生产选择评审过的不可变摘要。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is delayed label publication. The build itself finished successfully, right?
lines.zh: 当前假设是标签发布延迟。构建本身成功结束，对吧？

lines.en: Its signed provenance matches the new commit. The selected test artifact names yesterday's commit.
lines.zh: 它的签名来源证明匹配新提交。测试选中制品指向昨天提交。

lines.en: I'll select the expected digest explicitly. Then close the loop with corrected evidence.
lines.zh: 我明确选择预期摘要，然后带修正证据反馈闭环。

lines.en: Don't just update the screenshot manually. Add an assertion for the expected commit.
lines.zh: 别只手改截图。加上预期提交的断言。

lines.en: So, track the consumer fix separately. Changing tags alone isn't sufficient acceptance.
lines.zh: 那么单独跟踪消费端修复。只改标签不够验收。

lines.en: Validate signature and provenance on selection. Wrong or unsigned content must block the test.
lines.zh: 选择时验签和来源。错误或未签名内容必须阻止测试。

lines.en: Fair, I'll help trace label publication later. First Anika can fix deterministic selection.
lines.zh: 明白，稍后我帮追踪标签发布。先由Anika修确定性选择。

dialogues.title: 测试运行时和生产运行时不一致
dialogues.premise: 陈旧制品来自消费端标签选择，修复与缓存工作分开跟踪。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出环境一致性的范围和不在本次工作的升级。

lines.en: Environment parity has another gap today. Staging runs Java twenty-one; production runs seventeen.
lines.zh: 环境一致性今天还有缺口。预发布Java21，生产Java17。

lines.en: Okay, could that explain yesterday's stale artifact? Just to confirm, separate issues again?
lines.zh: 好，这能解释昨天陈旧制品吗？确认一下，又是独立问题？

lines.en: Yes, selection evidence separates those issues. Runtime mismatch affects what testing can establish.
lines.zh: 对，选择证据区分了问题。运行时差异影响测试能证明什么。

lines.en: We can't rule that out for compatibility. Let's align staging with production itself.
lines.zh: 兼容性方面不能排除它。让预发布与生产本身对齐吧。

lines.en: Agreed, use the approved seventeen image. A production runtime upgrade needs separate review.
lines.zh: 同意，用批准的17镜像。生产运行时升级需要另行评审。

lines.en: Managed configuration should pin that runtime digest. I'll add a parity check today.
lines.zh: 受管配置应固定那个运行时摘要。我今天加一致性检查。

lines.en: Keep environment-specific secret references distinct though. Parity doesn't mean sharing credentials across environments.
lines.zh: 但各环境秘密引用保持独立。一致性不等于跨环境共享凭据。

lines.en: So, rerun the smoke test after alignment. Don't claim earlier tests cover production compatibility.
lines.zh: 那么对齐后重跑冒烟测试。别声称旧测试覆盖生产兼容性。

lines.en: Include locale and timezone settings too. Those change catalog sorting and date behavior.
lines.zh: 也包括地区和时区设置。它们改变目录排序和日期行为。

lines.en: Fair, I'll test those fixture cases. No production runtime change in today's scope.
lines.zh: 明白，我测那些样例。今天范围不含生产运行时变更。

dialogues.title: 已经测了什么，还缺什么
dialogues.premise: 同意预发布对齐Java17，秘密引用保持环境独立；核对剩余测试。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分已通过测试与计划补充的覆盖。

lines.en: The regression suite covers digest selection now. Interrupted upload tests still need completion.
lines.zh: 回归测试集现在覆盖摘要选择。上传中断测试还没完成。

lines.en: Okay, environment parity comes before final runs. Just to confirm, include unknown outcomes?
lines.zh: 好，最终运行前先环境对齐。确认一下，包括结果未知的情况？

lines.en: Yes, simulate acknowledgement lost after completion. Retrying shouldn't upload or publish twice.
lines.zh: 对，模拟完成后确认丢失。重试不应上传或发布两次。

lines.en: Same operation key across retries, right? Attempt identifiers remain different for audit history.
lines.zh: 重试保留同一操作键，对吧？尝试标识不同以记录审计历史。

lines.en: Also test unsigned and wrong-signer objects. A valid checksum doesn't authorize a release.
lines.zh: 也测未签名和错误签名者对象。有效校验和不授权发布。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on flaky fixtures. One action item removes timing-dependent assertions.
lines.zh: 我关注不稳定样例。一个行动项是移除依赖时序的断言。

lines.en: Dry-run it first against test storage. Fault injection mustn't touch shared release objects.
lines.zh: 先对测试存储预演。故障注入不能碰共享发布对象。

lines.en: So, roughly how long for missing coverage? I'd rather report gaps than hide them.
lines.zh: 那么补缺大约多久？我宁愿报告缺口，不隐藏。

lines.en: One afternoon should cover these cases. Secret-redaction assertions belong in that set too.
lines.zh: 一个下午应能覆盖这些情况。秘密脱敏断言也加入。

lines.en: Fair, I'll supply the interruption harness today. Anika shouldn't have to rebuild that helper.
lines.zh: 明白，我今天提供中断测试工具。Anika不用重写那个辅助工具。

dialogues.title: 等待评审不是没有进展
dialogues.premise: 测试补缺安排到下午，代码等待安全与平台评审。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出评审等待原因和可以先完成的独立工作。

lines.en: My patch sits in the review queue. No reviewer response since yesterday afternoon.
lines.zh: 我的补丁在评审队列里。昨天下午起没有评审回应。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, not coding blocked? What's the ETA for review bandwidth?
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，不是编码阻塞？评审人何时有空？

lines.en: I can review environment changes at thirteen. Cache permissions need Hannah's security review separately.
lines.zh: 十三点我能评审环境变更。缓存权限另需Hannah安全评审。

lines.en: The regression suite can progress meanwhile. The suite itself doesn't need that merge.
lines.zh: 与此同时回归测试集能继续。测试集本身不需要那个合并。

lines.en: I have a reserved audit this morning. Fourteen is my earliest realistic review slot.
lines.zh: 今天上午我已有审计安排。最早实际可评审时段是十四点。

lines.en: Let's park that extra upload optimization. I'll split the current patch for review.
lines.zh: 额外上传优化先放一边。我拆分当前补丁供评审。

lines.en: Keep related security changes together, though. Tiny patches shouldn't hide a combined permission risk.
lines.zh: 但关联安全变更放一起。小补丁不能隐藏组合权限风险。

lines.en: So, one bounded cache review package. Separate environment work can move without bypassing checks.
lines.zh: 那么缓存形成边界清晰的评审包。独立环境工作可继续，不绕过检查。

lines.en: Attach test evidence before my slot starts. Otherwise review becomes another debugging appointment.
lines.zh: 我开始前附上测试证据。否则评审又变成调试时间。

lines.en: Fair, I'll update the ticket by noon. Waiting status should name the actual dependency.
lines.zh: 明白，中午前我更新工单。等待状态应写明实际依赖。

dialogues.title: 配对支持有明确输入和结束点
dialogues.premise: Lukas十三点评环境，Hannah十四点评缓存；Anika需要中断测试支持。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出帮助请求的具体任务、时段与验收。

lines.en: Can someone pair on this interruption test? I need the lost-acknowledgement fixture wired correctly.
lines.zh: 谁能一起做这个中断测试？我需要正确接入确认丢失样例。

lines.en: Okay, who has bandwidth before lunch? Just to confirm, it's test integration only?
lines.zh: 好，午饭前谁有空？确认一下，只是测试集成？

lines.en: Yes, not live deployment fault injection. Keep the review queue appointments intact today.
lines.zh: 对，不是线上部署故障注入。今天保留评审队列约定时段。

lines.en: I'm on it at eleven today. We can finish the wiring itself together.
lines.zh: 今天十一点我来。我们一起完成接入本身。

lines.en: Use sanitized fixtures and isolated storage. Don't record real tokens during the session.
lines.zh: 用脱敏样例和隔离存储。配对时别记录真实令牌。

lines.en: I'll prepare inputs before eleven then. About thirty minutes should be enough initially.
lines.zh: 那么十一点前我准备输入。初步约三十分钟应该够。

lines.en: Define the pass condition before pairing. One completed upload, two recorded attempts, no duplicate.
lines.zh: 配对前定义通过条件：完成一次上传、记录两次尝试，没有重复。

lines.en: So, let's take it offline at eleven. Stop after wiring if diagnosis runs longer.
lines.zh: 那么十一点会后处理。诊断拖长的话，接入后先停。

lines.en: Bring remaining questions to the review evidence. Don't silently stretch the pairing into release approval.
lines.zh: 剩余问题带到评审证据里。别暗自把配对扩展成发布审批。

lines.en: Fair, I'll document the helper's expected behavior. Anika can own the regression assertions afterward.
lines.zh: 明白，我记录辅助工具预期行为。之后Anika负责回归断言。

dialogues.title: 承诺交证据，不提前承诺上线
dialogues.premise: 十一点配对、十三点环境评审、十四点缓存评审已约定。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别各负责人当天交付的具体成果。

lines.en: Okay, today's priority is reviewable evidence. Not merging everything before the afternoon ends.
lines.zh: 好，今天优先事项是可评审证据，不是下午结束前合并一切。

lines.en: Just to recap, I'll pair on this first. Then attach cache tests by noon.
lines.zh: 小结一下，我先配对处理，然后中午前附上缓存测试。

lines.en: My action item is environment parity review. I'll document runtime and locale differences explicitly.
lines.zh: 我的行动项是环境一致性评审。我明确记录运行时和地区差异。

lines.en: Just to confirm, regression results by sixteen? I'll report failures, not just green totals.
lines.zh: 确认一下，十六点前回归结果？我报告失败，不只报绿色总数。

lines.en: I'll review cache permissions at fourteen. Missing evidence will be a named follow-up.
lines.zh: 十四点我评审缓存权限。缺失证据会成为明确跟进项。

lines.en: We'll close the loop at sixteen-thirty. Production rollout scheduling stays outside today's commitments.
lines.zh: 十六点三十分反馈闭环。生产发布排期不在今天承诺里。

lines.en: Good, review completion isn't deployment authorization. Keep approvals distinct from progress checkboxes.
lines.zh: 好，评审完成不是部署授权。审批与进度复选项区分。

lines.en: So, I'll publish the timing comparisons too. No eight-minute claim until tests support it.
lines.zh: 那么我也发布耗时对比。测试支持前不声称八分钟。

lines.en: And attach provenance for tested outputs. Evidence must reference the actual build inputs.
lines.zh: 也附被测输出的来源证明。证据必须引用实际构建输入。

lines.en: Fair, those deliverables are achievable today. I'll flag scope changes in the ticket itself.
lines.zh: 明白，这些今天可以交付。我在工单本身标出范围变化。

dialogues.title: 目标可能延期，提前给出选项
dialogues.premise: 当天证据和评审时点已确认，收尾更新本周目标风险。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出延期风险与不牺牲验证的备选安排。

lines.en: One delivery risk remains for Friday. Nine minutes is measured; eight isn't proven.
lines.zh: 周五还有一个交付风险。九分钟已测出，八分钟未证明。

lines.en: Okay, today's priority stays evidence and review. Just to confirm, don't drop checks?
lines.zh: 好，今天优先仍是证据和评审。确认一下，不删检查？

lines.en: Correct, report the realistic measured gain. Removing tests isn't an acceptable optimization plan.
lines.zh: 对，报告真实测得收益。移除测试不是可接受的优化方案。

lines.en: Maybe split the target into two milestones. Safe reuse first, further optimization later itself.
lines.zh: 可能把目标拆成两个里程碑。先安全复用，进一步优化本身放之后。

lines.en: That works if acceptance stays explicit. Signature, secret isolation, and provenance remain mandatory.
lines.zh: 验收明确就可行。签名、秘密隔离、来源证明仍强制。

lines.en: Extra profiling needs more bandwidth next week. I'll estimate that after today's test results.
lines.zh: 下周额外分析需要更多人手。今天测试结果后我估算。

lines.en: Don't convert review delay into incident urgency. We can negotiate scope with measured trade-offs.
lines.zh: 别把评审延迟变成故障紧急状态。可以用测得的取舍协商范围。

lines.en: So, let's circle back at sixteen-thirty. We'll close the loop with updated evidence.
lines.zh: 那么十六点三十分再确认。用更新证据反馈闭环。

lines.en: If review discovers another security gap, report it. The progress board mustn't hide unresolved findings.
lines.zh: 评审发现新安全缺口就报告。进度板不能隐藏未决发现。

lines.en: Fair, I'll update the board now. Today's plan is clear without promising production speed.
lines.zh: 明白，我现在更新进度板。今天计划清楚，但不承诺生产速度。
